subject: Deploy mature phase-locked focus motion to Design resident
body: Deploy exact Candidate 01 branch head 6d48dcded9fd377cfe0fef38d5f070d06e0bfe9a to the local Doré Design resident. Preserve Visual Editorial Director and 4W. This cut replaces competing CSS current animation with a single phase-arbitrated motion loop: settled -> drift -> intent -> arrest -> locked -> focus -> release -> settled -> drift. It also makes the arbitration layer explicitly replay mouseleave into the existing Codrops close path so expanded preview cannot remain latched. Do not merge to public homepage.

argv: HTML=$(curl -fsS 'http://127.0.0.1:4310/editor-canvas?page=living-water-candidate-01'); printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'candidate-01-living-editorial-runtime' && printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'phase-lock-' && printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'replayLeave' && printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'data-motion-phase' && ! printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q '@keyframes lw-current-a'

python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request
base='http://127.0.0.1:4310'
h=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/api/health'))
html=urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/editor-canvas?page=living-water-candidate-01').read().decode()
checks={
 'phase_lock':'phase-lock-' in html,
 'replay_leave':'replayLeave' in html,
 'raf':'requestAnimationFrame(tick)' in html,
 'no_css_current_keyframes':'@keyframes lw-current-a' not in html,
 'visual_director':'dore.visual-editorial-director.v1' in html,
 'uniform_8x5':'aspect-ratio:8/5!important' in html,
}
print(json.dumps({'ok':all(checks.values()),'deployed_sha':'6d48dcded9fd377cfe0fef38d5f070d06e0bfe9a','health':h,'checks':checks},ensure_ascii=False))
assert all(checks.values())
PY
